rule: A sell action must state or clearly enact the completed transfer of the stated quantity and good at the stated unit price. A quote or future offer is insufficient. Out-of-stock and counter-offer lines must not claim a sale.

notes.1: The rejected judge result is a valid counter-offer at ten coins and does not claim a sale.
notes.19: Take one apple enacts the completed transfer of one apple at five coins.
notes.62: The rejected judge result counters at four coins and does not claim a sale.
notes.72: Semantically sound out-of-stock line, but it exceeds the 45-word check and remains excluded.

excluded_policy: All other rows are excluded. In particular, most sell_list_price lines merely state a price, propose a sale, or promise a future handover. Several multi-item lines misstate the total or leave it ambiguous.
